senses.gloss:
छुर् छुर्, cl. 6. P. छुरति, चुच्छोर,
छुरितुम्, &c., to cut, engrave, incise,
etch: Caus. छुरयति and छोरयति, -यितुम्, to
inlay, veneer, to set with mosaic ornaments; [cf.
क्षुर्; cf. also Hib. scuirim or sguirim, ‘I cease,
desist,’ cf. छेद; Old Germ. scar, sciru, &c.;
Mod. Germ. Schere.]

छूरिका, f. = छुरिका in छूरिका-पत्त्री, N. of a
plant, = श्वेता, Andropogon Aciculatus; the mouth
of a cow; (other readings have खुरिका, स्फुरिका,
स्थुरिका, स्थूरिका.)

छुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, inlaid, set, coated, spread;
blended, intermingled.
—छुरितोदर (˚त-उद्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, pierced through the belly; transfixed.
